leaves.name: shimuraMainThmIDeligneY3AbU
leaves.doc: gt-rayclass (shimura-cft, rayclass-cft), composite of printed theorems: Shimura's Main Theorem I for the level-3 group K3 of B = (2,-3|Q) in Deligne's adelic form on the fine moduli scheme Y3 of QM abelian surfaces (R1fpPropsAb): the uniformization B^x_+ \ (H x (B (x) A_f)^x) / K3 = Y3(C), holomorphy in tau, the moduli clause at every u in O-hat^x (the object at Psi(tau,u) is C^2/iota(O)(tau,1)^T) and Shimura's reciprocity law at CM points. Replaces rayClassCMAb and shimuraFamilyAb.
leaves.source: Shimura, Ann. of Math. 85 (1967) Main Theorem I (reciprocity at CM points); Deligne, Sem. Bourbaki 389 (1971) sections 3-4 (adelic form, PEL moduli interpretation, canonical model); Milne, Introduction to Shimura varieties sections 12-14; fine moduli of QM abelian surfaces with level 3 (R1fpPropsAb, as for r1r2Ab); locators UNVERIFIED

leaves.name: shimuraIntegralModelRep
leaves.doc: Representability over Z_(p), p > 324, of the moduli problem of QM abelian surfaces (disc 6) with full level 3, by a proper smooth curve (printed form on QMAbScheme): Kottwitz, J. AMS 5 (1992) 5; Buzzard, Duke 87 (1997) 1-4; Morita, Hokkaido 10 (1981); locators UNVERIFIED
leaves.flag: pending reading: Kottwitz 1992 section 5 is the PEL functor; the polarization-free integral form needs a relative Lemma P over every locally noetherian base and the rational-to-integral level comparison; Buzzard and Morita may require level prime to D (level 3 at 3 | 6); locators UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Kottwitz, J. AMS 5 (1992) section 5; Buzzard, Duke Math. J. 87 (1997) sections 1-4; Morita, Hokkaido Math. J. 10 (1981); Carayol, Compositio 59 (1986) secondary (locators UNVERIFIED); Lan 2013, Thms 1.4.1.11 and 5.3.3.1 (second locators)
